title: Permission Request
description: File ONLY for critical work: an action that costs money or needs access beyond what the agent already has. Everything else is done without a form. No form, no command: the command runs only after Frisky marks it Approve. Vague entries are rejected.

publish_status.note: No Tally plugin or connector exists right now, so no live Tally form exists. This file is the source definition; publish it to Tally or an equivalent once a credential-free route exists.

fields.label: Exact action
fields.help: The exact command or operation, e.g. 'Buy the $49/yr Studio plan', not 'set up billing'.

fields.label: Exact target
fields.help: The specific resource: repo, account, product ID, URL, server, vault item.

fields.label: Why it can't wait
fields.help: Concrete consequence of delay. No vague reasons.

fields.label: Cost (money or new access)
fields.help: Amount and currency, and/or the exact new access or credential scope needed.
